change: Desktop hot corner: after the corner's Win+D the controller minimizes the application windows Win+D only covered (ShowWindowAsync SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE) and tags them with a window property. In Explorer a SwitchToThisWindow detour (src/desktop-restore-latest.inc) only activates a tagged minimized window instead of letting the system post SC_RESTORE, which takes Windows Terminal out of fullscreen; the controller, which holds an EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND hook while tagged windows remain, shows it with ShowWindowAsync(SW_RESTORE). If the window is still minimized after 250 ms the system call runs unchanged. The same corner on the desktop before another window was used returns all of them. Replaces 0.8.94 to 0.8.98; see docs/desktop-sweep-latest.md.
